Interlinking packages via dependencies to create complex dependency chains
Potentially causing Denial of Service (DoS) attacks on registries and client machines
Using hardcoded blockchain addresses in code linked to a crypto token reward protocol

Using transitive dependencies to cause resource exhaustion
Forking and cloning existing open source code repositories to create many variants

Packages named with gibberish Latin phrases similar to Lorem Ipsum
Presence of 'web3c.js' file with hardcoded blockchain addresses
